modality_status: Planned interface options; this file does not enable speech/video or implement recording/transcription.

stages.label: Welcome, participation and channel setup
stages.purpose: Make the purpose and participation clear before asking for personal information.
stages.entry: New session or resumption needing context/permission clarification.
activities: Introduce the AI assessment-support role honestly.
Confirm adult-scope eligibility using supplied case/intake information rather than guessing.
Confirm text/voice/video availability, accessibility and permissions for any transcription/recording.
Explain pause/skip/stop and relevant use of conversation content.
stages.exit: Person chooses to proceed and the channel is usable; otherwise pause, clarify access or provide an appropriate handoff.

stages.label: Patient main concern and priorities
stages.purpose: Understand what brought the person and what they want help with.
stages.entry: Person is willing and able to begin.
activities: Start with an open invitation.
Listen and acknowledge in context without presuming symptoms.
Capture relevant symptoms, time course and impact already volunteered.
Retain goals, communication preferences and practical priorities for care planning.
stages.exit: There is enough context to choose a focused next target, or a safety/access concern changes priority.

stages.label: Natural conversation with ongoing assessment
stages.purpose: Collect and clarify relevant evidence during the conversation.
stages.entry: A meaningful unanswered target remains and the person wants to continue.
activities: Normalize text or speech to source-linked messages with speaker/time context.
Extractor reviews the whole available conversation and existing evidence.
Update concept-specific details, corrections, periods and uncertainties.
Planner chooses one useful missing target from applicable knowledge.
Conversational role asks that target naturally using prior context.
Use standardized tools only through a separately specified instrument protocol; placement is not decided here.
stages.exit: Enough information for a useful summary/review, the person pauses/stops, or a concern requires another pathway; this is not an automatic diagnosis-completion test.
stages.owner: Extractor, planner and conversational role; application guards

stages.label: Summary and patient clarification
stages.purpose: Check that the account is represented accurately before handoff/formulation.
stages.entry: A useful summary can be offered, including an incomplete assessment.
activities: Summarize reported symptoms, course, impact and relevant context.
State uncertainties without filling gaps.
Invite corrections and additions.
Return clinically meaningful corrections to extraction and planning.
stages.exit: Summary is ready for review with its confirmation status, or more clarification is appropriate; no reply is not confirmation.
stages.owner: Conversational role; evidence update; later summarization component

stages.label: Provisional impressions and professional review
stages.purpose: Organize possible explanations and their uncertainty for a qualified diagnostic judgment.
stages.entry: Available evidence and its limitations can be reviewed; full certainty is not required for an appropriate handoff.
activities: Later synthesis component compares evidence with relevant category and alternative requirements.
Separate supporting/conflicting evidence, unknowns and unresolved source questions.
Qualified professional reviews and may confirm, revise or defer a diagnosis.
Record who made a formulation, when and its status; the AI does not label itself the diagnosing clinician.
stages.exit: The responsible professional/workflow identifies appropriate next care or further assessment; no reviewer available does not count as approval.
stages.owner: Planned clinical synthesis and qualified professional review

stages.label: Discuss and agree next care
stages.purpose: Choose appropriate next steps with the person, based on needs, reviewed findings and preferences.
stages.entry: An appropriate review-informed proposal can be discussed; provisional/uncertain diagnoses may still allow support, referral or continued assessment.
activities: Discuss suitable options in understandable terms.
Consider goals, preferences, barriers, history and availability.
Agree what happens next and when it will be reviewed.
Record actual agreement and clinical authorization where required.
Medication decisions remain with qualified prescribers.
stages.exit: Agreed applicable actions can proceed; otherwise continue discussion, arrange review or close with pending needs.
stages.owner: Planned care-planning component, responsible professional and patient

stages.label: Agreed therapy or management support
stages.purpose: Support the selected, appropriate therapeutic activities and management plan.
stages.entry: Relevant plan is agreed and required clinical review/authorization and capability checks are actually satisfied.
activities: Use only applicable selected approaches such as CBT, BA or IPT within the approved scope.
Update therapy formulation, activities and agreed homework with provenance.
Keep patient reports separate from suggested reframes or clinician hypotheses.
Route new clinical or safety information back to assessment/review.
stages.exit: Activity/session ends, plan needs review, person pauses, or current concerns change the pathway.
stages.owner: Later therapy/management components and responsible care team

stages.label: Close, monitor and plan follow-up
stages.purpose: End clearly and track meaningful change across contacts.
stages.entry: Assessment or therapy contact is ending, including an incomplete or paused assessment.
activities: Summarize what was discussed and actually agreed.
Record remaining questions and review/contact status.
Set homework only if selected and agreed; no homework is a valid outcome.
Compare future symptoms, function and goals with the actual baseline; no invented improvement or scores.
At a later contact, use the agreed agenda and re-enter the relevant assessment/review/care stage.
stages.exit: Session closes with accurate status; future review reopens the appropriate stage rather than requiring the whole intake again.
stages.owner: Conversation, later summary/monitoring components and care team

edges.condition: Patient correction or important gap merits clarification
Available account ready for provisional review
Applicable plan agreed; required clinical authorization/capability verified
Support/referral/continued assessment or deferred therapy agreed

global_interrupts.condition: Reported current safety or acute medical/clinical concerns require prompt human/medical review.
global_interrupts.action: Interrupt ordinary progression and follow the setting-specific reviewed pathway. Record concerns, uncertainty and actual contact/delivery status.
global_interrupts.return_rule: Resume only through an appropriate clinical/workflow decision; a flag does not establish resolution.

global_interrupts.condition: Person pauses/declines/stops, channel fails, or required capability is unavailable.
global_interrupts.action: Respect participation; preserve evidence and unresolved items. Provide an appropriate summary/handoff when feasible; do not invent agreement or diagnostic completion.
global_interrupts.return_rule: If resuming, restore verified history and recheck context rather than restart blindly.
